Keep the SAME adult male athlete, short dark hair, medium tan skin, deep forest green singlet, near-black green sprint shorts and ivory sprint spikes. Match the reference identity, material detail and warm afternoon lighting. Preserve the artistic quality but REPLACE the old animation: it repeats nearly the same lead leg and needs a genuinely continuous alternating sprint cycle.

This is a single LOOP of a complete right-plus-left sprint stride. Character travels RIGHT in strict lateral SIDE VIEW, no 3/4 turn, no moving camera. No text, frame numbers, borders, grid lines, logos, ground, cast shadows, backdrop or fake checkerboard. Real transparent alpha around every figure, no matte. Explicitly distinguish near RIGHT leg/arm from far LEFT leg/arm using overlap and shading, with the far limbs a little darker. Both knees bend in the natural forward direction. Arms bent about90 degrees and swing OPPOSITE the same-side leg. Do not repeat the same arm posture in the second half.
Chronological pose chart for the ONE FULL cycle:
0 near RIGHT foot lands just forward of hip, far left knee recovering; LEFT arm forward, right arm back.
1 right foot loads, sole planted slightly ahead of hip, left heel folds upward.
2 right midstance sole below hip, left thigh swings forward, arms passing.
3 right forefoot pushes rearward, left knee driving forward, right arm advancing.
4 right toe-off far behind hip, left knee high in front, LEFT arm back and right arm forward.

6 left foot approaches ground ahead, right heel recovers toward buttock, arms continue opposing.
7 left foot descending just above ground; a smooth approach to frame8, no pose jump.
8 far LEFT foot lands forward of hip, right knee recovering; RIGHT arm forward, left arm back. This MUST show the opposite leg and arm from frame0.
9 left foot loads planted ahead, right heel folds upward.
10 left midstance sole below hip, right thigh swings forward.
11 left forefoot pushes rearward, right knee driving forward, left arm advancing.
12 left toe-off behind hip, right knee high forward; right arm back and left arm forward.
13 second flight: left leg back, right shin unfolding forward, both shoes above ground.
14 right foot approaches ground ahead, left heel recovering toward buttock.
15 right foot descending just above ground, connecting smoothly back to frame0.
